points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable 17a5ef3 CMake build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 processes; CTest found no tests. Historical executable is not bound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:34–35 accepts --restart but solver.cpp:23–27 only stores it and no read implementation exists; output.cpp:441–450 writes only rank-zero-owned state. Case-driven parsing and error paths exist.

points.notes: Modular mesh/flux/partition/solver/output source.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal wrapper evidence observed; trust policy prohibits external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case paths are parsed; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:61 uses METIS and neighbor halos exist, but solver.hpp:64 and solver.cpp:165–205 retain a complete global mesh on every rank throughout iterations; no valid controlled np1/np8 comparison established.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Recovered M0.15 inviscid/laminar histories are strongly unstable; selected M2 inviscid point field has Mach maximum 3.166e15. Do not apply stale report billion-scale laminar numbers to recovered cases.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Independent validator passed all eight recovered cases and report yet accepted eight empty final-field sentinels; clean build succeeds but CTest finds no tests. Valid numerical or rank-consistency demonstration remains lacking.

points.notes: Readable but debug sources/build products existed only in historical raw tree.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix

points.notes: Green-Gauss reconstruction present.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: flux.cpp:216–236 implements Newtonian stress and heat flux, and solver.cpp:1030–1036 estimates tangential wall shear. Selected laminar force histories drift or oscillate and do not establish credible convergence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Point-implicit diagonal LU-SGS approximation.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 source exists, but Re200 uses fixed 15 inner iterations and strict target is miscounted.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition and neighbor exchange are implemented, but persistent full mesh exists on each rank during iteration; historical np1 result histories are empty/failed, so rank consistency is not established.

disqualification_flags.text: transient status and inner-success count use unsupported success criteria
disqualification_flags.evidence: Immutable solver.cpp:55–62 declares Re200 completed and statistically_periodic; :743–748 caps inner iterations at 15, and :845–852 counts a miss only at ratio >=1 rather than the configured 0.001. Correction 2026-10-31: original metadata was recovered from contestant checkpoint f9b3d2d86be7691191d72b8b323de4c503a2597a, SHA256 bb6ec9e31484739fb64406961f3d91341a8e1e65337f7dc07c2187e5b70fa46e; it reports last ratio 0.9284884538816688, 731 misses and fraction 0.9756333333333334. Source counts ratio>=1 rather than target 0.001, so 731 is not the strict-target miss count. Binary unbound. In recovered f9b3d2d naca0012_m015_inviscid_np1 and cylinder_m010_laminar_re20_np1, metadata says completed=true/converged while run_status says failed at final_step=0 and forces.csv has zero data rows; these are further direct DQ7 examples and cannot serve as valid rank comparisons.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight f9b3d2d field_final.vtu files are 474-byte empty placeholders; separate rank point-sample VTUs exist. Restart write is rank-zero local only and read is absent. Validator nevertheless accepts structure.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Fresh read-only benchmark validation of all eight f9b3d2d case directories and historical report directory returns OK, including empty final-field files. Structural acceptance does not prove physics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Recovered M0.15 histories unstable, M080/M2 laminar and Re20 drag drift, Re200 last ratio 0.928488 and late-force behavior lacks credible shedding, despite successful metadata.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd 0.338 is low and drifting; M2 inviscid sample field has Mach maximum 3.166e15; force histories are not settled. Billion-scale laminar values in report are stale, not selected checkpoint results.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical PDF has missing-figure placeholders; independently delivered nested residual/force and centroid-sample plots exist. Re200 has a readable late force plot, showing drift, rather than no late-force figure.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report table has stale and sign-inverted values versus selected f9b3d2d forces, missing figures, and claims no mesh replication despite source. The explicit diagonal-implicit disclosure is credited.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Historical table differs from recovered forces and figure manifest names empty field_final.vtu although separate rank fields contain centroid samples. Exact historical executable and some plot generation bindings remain unproven.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

Original eight case packages, Re200 metadata and 22-page historical contestant PDF were recovered from f9b3d2d; prior workspace-only absence assertions are superseded. Production sources, CMake and report TeX match curated submission aside from deleted debug-only sources, but exact historical binary is unbound. Case scores and full review remain provisional.

Mandatory placeholder rejection: each historical eight-rank required field_final.vtu is empty despite separate per-rank point-sample VTUs and PVTU. Full case, rubric and figure review remains provisional.

Historical f9b3d2d PDF and nested case figures were visually reviewed; the PDF contains explicit [Figure pending] boxes, so it remains historical contestant evidence rather than an approved main-PDF snapshot. Report table values are stale or sign-inverted relative to checkpoint forces; individual case notes distinguish these data.
